Casos.texto0: Connectivity and video surveillance in one project. At Servicentro San Juan, SG Solutions integrated the network infrastructure and IP camera system, with equipment organized in cabinets and a screen to view the monitored areas.

Casos.texto1: Technology for customer service across ECOFARMA pharmacies. The project integrates point-of-sale stations with barcode scanners, receipt printers and cash drawers, along with cabinets that organize and protect the technology infrastructure at each location.

Casos.respuesta1: Stations were installed with monitors, keyboards, barcode scanners, receipt printers and cash drawers, along with cabinets for the technology equipment.
Casos.valorado1: Equipped service points and organized infrastructure that support operations across the different pharmacies.

Casos.titulo2: Point-of-sale stations and IP surveillance camera system
Casos.texto2: Point-of-sale stations and IP surveillance for Eco Mini Market. Our team worked on installing the service stations and the store’s camera system, bringing together the equipment and peripherals used in the business’s operations.
Casos.situacion2: The store required point-of-sale stations and IP video surveillance to support its operations.
Casos.respuesta2: The point-of-sale equipment was installed and configured along with the IP cameras intended for store surveillance.
Casos.valorado2: Equipment ready for operation and a surveillance solution prepared according to the establishment’s needs.

terminos.descripcion: Conditions for browsing products, requesting services and arranging orders with SG Solutions.

0.titulo: Who we are and how to contact us
0.texto: SG Solutions provides technology equipment, advice and services in Costa Rica. Contact us at soporte@sgsolutionscr.com, 2446-7846 or WhatsApp +506 6439-9417. Our office is at Plaza El Bosque, Atenas.

1.texto: Published prices are in Costa Rican colones and include VAT where indicated. Supplier availability requires confirmation. Images may show regional variants; check the manufacturer part number and product specifications. Before confirming a purchase, we will provide the product, total price, taxes, delivery and any additional costs. If a discrepancy or error is found, we will inform you before payment so you can decide. We will not substitute products without your authorization.

2.texto: Adding products to the cart or reviewing a form does not constitute payment or a reservation. The site prepares a request for you to review and send through the indicated channel. SG Solutions will confirm availability and conditions before arranging the purchase. Do not pay until you receive that confirmation. These steps do not limit any rights arising from an offer or contract under applicable law.

3.texto: Payments are currently arranged by SINPE Móvil or bank transfer after confirming the order and recipient. Card payments on the site are not yet enabled, and we do not request card numbers or security codes. Delivery or collection, costs and timing are agreed before payment. Billing details must be accurate. A transfer receipt requires verification of funds and does not, by itself, confirm delivery.

4.texto: Products and services carry the warranty rights established by Costa Rican law. Specific warranty conditions will be provided before purchase and in the relevant documents. To report a defect, an incorrect delivery or request a return, email us with the order reference and a description. Applicable withdrawal, repair, replacement or refund rights will be honored. These conditions do not exclude statutory rights or require complaints to be handled solely by the manufacturer. You may submit a request through the channel used to enter into the transaction.

5.texto: An inquiry or plan request does not automatically activate a service or subscription. Diagnosis, scope, price, hours, response times, visits, term and cancellation conditions will be detailed in the accepted proposal. Response time is not a resolution deadline. Authorization and necessary data handling will be arranged before work on equipment or remote access. We recommend keeping current backups; this does not release SG Solutions from its legal responsibilities.

6.titulo: Use of the site and content
6.texto: Use forms with accurate information and only when authorized to provide it. Do not use the site for impersonation, unauthorized access or interference with the service. Trademarks, photographs and content belong to their respective owners; their presence does not imply any affiliation beyond what is expressly stated. External links are also subject to their providers’ terms.

7.texto: These conditions are interpreted under Costa Rican law. Updates will show their date and will not retroactively change agreed conditions. Nothing here waives consumer rights or prevents recourse to competent authorities. Data handling is explained in the Privacy Policy.

privacidad.descripcion: How information is used when browsing, viewing products or requesting assistance from SG Solutions.

0.texto: SG Solutions receives and manages sales and support inquiries through its service channels. For privacy questions or requests about your data, email soporte@sgsolutionscr.com. Our office is at Plaza El Bosque, Atenas, Costa Rica.

1.texto: Depending on the form and request, we may receive your name, email, phone, company, billing details, identification, delivery address, selected products and messages about the required service. Provide only necessary and authorized information. Do not include passwords, full card numbers, security codes or sensitive data in messages or forms.

2.texto: We use information to answer inquiries, prepare quotes, arrange orders and delivery, invoice, handle support, warranties and complaints, and meet legal obligations. Required fields support the request; some actions cannot be completed without them. Sending an inquiry does not authorize unrelated advertising. Any additional purpose requiring consent must be explained separately.

3.texto: Current forms let you review a request before opening WhatsApp or email with a prepared message. Opening these links shares the message data with the channel provider; you must complete sending there for SG Solutions to receive the request. WhatsApp, Microsoft Outlook, maps and social networks apply their own policies and may process data outside Costa Rica. Card payments are not active on this site. If a payment gateway is enabled, its provider and data handling will be disclosed before use.

4.texto: The sg-idioma cookie remembers your language for up to one year. The cart stores product identifiers and quantities in your browser’s local storage under sg-carrito-v1 until you empty it or clear site data. Form fields are retained during interaction with the page. Private staff access may use authentication cookies. Your analytics and advertising choice is stored in your browser; only with your permission are first-party navigation events recorded and Meta Pixel loaded for advertising. You can change your choice through Privacy preferences and clear browser data, although preferences or sessions will be lost.

5.texto: Request information is intended for staff handling it and, when needed to fulfill it, delivery, support, email or infrastructure providers. Hosting may process technical connection data such as IP addresses and security logs. This does not itself authorize other commercial uses. Information is retained as necessary for the request and applicable legal obligations; deletion requests take those duties into account. Communications are also subject to the retention practices of your chosen channel.

6.titulo: Your rights and how to exercise them
6.texto: You may request information about your data, access, correction, updating, deletion or withdrawal of consent as applicable under Law 8968. Email the privacy contact with your request and a reply address. We may ask for the minimum verification needed to avoid disclosing data to others. Withdrawal does not remove statutory retention duties. You may also contact Costa Rica’s data protection authority, PRODHAB.

7.texto: Processing must be limited to the stated purpose and the access needed to fulfill it. No Internet channel is risk-free; avoid sharing unnecessary information. This policy will be updated when services or data use change, with a revision date. New processing requiring consent is not authorized merely by publishing an update.

Analitica.privacidadDetalle: With your permission, we record navigation events, product views, appearances in searches, cart additions and contact clicks. We use a random session identifier and retain these first-party events for 30 days; search text and form data are not recorded. Analytics is stored in Supabase. With separate advertising consent, Meta Pixel may send navigation and interaction events to Meta, which processes them according to its privacy policy. You can withdraw permission for future events through Privacy preferences; this does not delete data already sent to Meta.
